title: Crash after base CAS is recovered as landed
notes: This fixture omits the optional acceptance key and uses the spec v1.2 default adapter, exunit. Installed Kogen b73a0534 rejects the spec-defined acceptance project key as unknown during approval; that is Kogen drift. Approval reads the implementation-advertised digest so this downstream case can proceed despite the hash drift directly tested in v1.2-02.

write.text:
#!/bin/sh
case_dir='{case}'
origin='{origin}'
path_no_wrapper=$(printf '%s' "$PATH" | sed 's|^[^:]*:||')
PATH=$path_no_wrapper
real_git=$(command -v git) || exit 127
"$real_git" "$@"
result=$?
ref_seen=0
new_value=
want_value=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  if [ "$want_value" = 1 ]; then new_value=$arg; break; fi
  if [ "$arg" = refs/heads/main ]; then ref_seen=1; want_value=1; fi
done
if [ "$result" = 0 ] && [ "$ref_seen" = 1 ]; then
  tip=$("$real_git" --git-dir "$origin" rev-parse --verify refs/heads/main 2>/dev/null)
  incoming=$("$real_git" --git-dir "$origin" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/kogen/incoming/)
  if [ "$tip" = "$new_value" ] && [ -n "$incoming" ]; then
    : > "$case_dir/post-cas"
    while [ ! -f "$case_dir/release-git" ]; do sleep 0.02; done
  fi
fi
exit "$result"
